name: io.github.CodePhantom-1/kultranz-mcp
title: Kultranz: US Salary, Tax & Cost of Living
description: US take-home pay, 2026 tax brackets, BLS wages by job and city, and cost of living across 50 metros.

tools.name: get_take_home_pay
tools.description: Calculate net (take-home) pay from a gross US salary for 2026: federal income tax, Social Security to the annual wage base, Medicare including the additional Medicare surcharge, and state income tax for any of the 50 states or DC. State rules differ substantially and nine states levy no income tax. Free and read-only; tool calls are rate-limited per IP.

salary.description: Gross annual salary in USD, e.g. 120000

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. CA, NY, TX, DC

filingStatus.description: single, or mfj for married filing jointly. Defaults to single.

pretax401k.description: Optional annual pre-tax 401(k) contribution in USD

tools.name: compare_cost_of_living
tools.description: Compare the cost of living between two US metro areas and return the equivalent salary — the income needed in the second city to hold the same purchasing power. Uses BEA Regional Price Parities where the US average is 100. Answers 'is X more expensive than Y' and 'what salary do I need in Y to match X'. Accepts a plain city name ("Austin") or the listed form ("Austin, TX") for any of the 50 supported metros.

fromCity.description: Origin metro, e.g. "Austin, TX" or just "Austin"

toCity.description: Destination metro, e.g. "San Francisco, CA" or just "San Francisco"

salary.description: Salary in USD to convert. Defaults to 100000.

tools.name: get_tax_brackets
tools.description: Return the 2026 IRS federal income tax brackets and standard deduction, and optionally one state's income tax rules (none, flat, or progressive with its own brackets). Use when asked what bracket someone is in or how a state taxes income.

state.description: Optional two-letter state code to include alongside the federal brackets

filingStatus.description: single, or mfj for married filing jointly. Defaults to single.

tools.name: list_metros
tools.description: List all 50 supported US metro areas with their BEA Regional Price Parity index (US average = 100), median rent, median home value and median household income. Pass a city to return just that one. The names returned are the 50 metros the cost-of-living comparison supports.

tools.name: get_salary_percentiles
tools.description: Return real BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics annual wages — 10th, 25th, median, 75th and 90th percentile — for an occupation, optionally narrowed to a metro or state, alongside the metro's cost-of-living index. Use this to answer 'what does a nurse earn in Chicago' or 'am I underpaid' with sourced figures.
